title: Listening Drill — Printmaking class
description: Booking dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Printmaking class
sections.transcript:
CALLER: Hello. I'd like to book a printmaking class. I saw an older notice saying that bookings opened on Sunday morning. Is that still right?

ADVISER: That notice is out of date. Bookings open on Monday this time. If you collect your booking pack in person, go to the exhibition desk. The reception desk in the main building won't have the packs.

CALLER: How much is the booking? I can pay online if that saves time.

ADVISER: The total is twenty-five pounds. Pay once you've checked the date. Then contact Ruby if you haven't received confirmation within two working days.

CALLER: Thanks. Is there anything else I should know before I arrive?

ADVISER: One practical detail: the ink may stain clothing.
